column1: # /File Save persists the workbook's external_sources registry as a
# sidecar inside the xlsx zip; /File Retrieve loads it back. The
# binding (connection + last query) survives a save → close → reopen.
KEYS SELECT id, name, qty FROM items ORDER BY id
# Retrieve the workbook — wipes memory, re-reads from disk.
# The /Use cell values landed in the workbook proper, so they survive
# a vanilla reload regardless of the sidecar.
# The binding itself round-trips through the sidecar: /DEL on the
# Refresh proves the *binding* survived too — the stashed query
# replays and rewrites the bound range.
